_notes.schema: v4.8: every key here is read by hooks/scripts (tests/test_settings_example.py pins both directions). Booleans accept true/false or the strings "true"/"false"; a malformed value falls back to its default without resetting its section.
_notes.layout_version: Integer schema version. v3 is current (topic-FOLDER + dated-aspect layout).
_notes.auto_journal: Stop-hook journal cadence: every journal_every REAL user turns the main session dispatches a background memory teammate (templates/auto-journal-instructions.md).
_notes.journal: v3.6 active forgetting. raw_ttl_days: archive raw journals older than N days; max_bytes: also archive a >1-day-old journal over this size; salvage: lift curated entries (v4.9: `- [type]` bullets, `## [type]` blocks, bare `[type]` lines) into journal/_salvage.md first; auto_forget_enabled: run _forget.py from the Stop hook (once per day).
_notes.reflection: v4.0 self-review loop. `enabled` gates the review cadence (every turn_interval real turns a fresh-context judge is dispatched; deferred until the session log holds min_review_turns blocks). Per-turn capture into journal/sessions/ is gated by capture_enabled, which DEFAULTS to `enabled` — deliberately absent here so enabled:false stays a privacy opt-out (session logs sync to the git remote). max_prompt_chars is clamped to 8192.
_notes.gate: v3.6 write-time quality gate (deterministic). strict: reject hedged claims without evidence; english_only: curated entries must be English (journal stays bilingual).
_notes.tags: v4.0 deterministic auto-tagging on the write path (inline #tags + frontmatter tags:, indexed as a weighted FTS5 column).
_notes.topic_routing: min_keyword_overlap: keyword overlap a topic needs to receive a routed entry; default_topic: where an entry goes when nothing matches.
_notes.topic_layout: v4.1 aspect retention: when auto_archive_enabled is true the Stop hook archives aspects older than archive_threshold_days (newest 3 per topic always kept). Default off; run /mem-ops forget --aspects by hand.
_notes.topic_card: v4.9 topic cards (_card.py, /mem-topic card): max_chars is the budget of one card body in code points (a positive integer; anything else means 2000). A longer body is refused (rejected:over_budget) and an existing one is flagged by _validate.py (card-over-budget).
_notes.workspace: default: workspace when nothing else resolves; auto_detect_from_cwd: match config.json workspace_map globs against the session cwd.
_notes.retrieval: index_archive: also index .archive/**.gz so forgotten material stays searchable with /mem-recall --archive. daily_full_reindex (v4.8): once per day the Stop hook starts a detached full rebuild of an EXISTING index.db (the per-Stop incremental pass handles the rest; a Stop never creates the index).
_notes.sync: auto_sync_on_stop: debounced detached commit+pull+push from the Stop hook; min_interval_minutes: the debounce (floor 5).
_notes.doctor: auto_heal: let SessionStart run bin/doctor.sh detached to repair a stale plugin registration (no network). Also GOWTH_MEM_NO_AUTOHEAL=1.
_notes.native: v4.8: keep <ws>/memory/MEMORY.md (Claude Code auto memory, 200 lines / 25 KB, re-attached after compaction) as the bootstrap carrier. Wire a project with /mem-setup native. enabled:false → the SessionStart hook prints the ≤8,500-char fallback bootstrap instead.
_notes.recall: v4.8 per-prompt recall (UserPromptSubmit, BM25, no LLM). on_prompt_enabled: master switch; on_prompt_max_entries / on_prompt_max_chars: injection caps; on_prompt_min_terms: distinct query terms a chunk must contain; on_prompt_min_coverage: share (0-1) of the prompt's content terms the chunk must contain — 0.5 measured on the live vault: 0-3/20 generic prompts inject per workspace vs 14/20 with the 2-term gate alone, 29/30 real paraphrases still served; the prompt's subject term (first identifier, else longest word) is always required; on_prompt_score_threshold: bm25 (negative, lower is better) a chunk must reach; "auto" (default) = min(-1, 2.5 - 1.55 × ln(live index chunks)) because bm25 scales with corpus idf (measured 2026-09-28 on a 15.6k-chunk vault: generic prompts score -5 … -9.7, real queries -14 … -88, so 15.6k → -12.5; a 6-chunk vault → -1) — a number pins it; on_prompt_prompt_cap: chars of the prompt that are profiled.
_notes.memfile: v4.8 budget of the managed block in MEMORY.md (the host reads 200 lines / 25 KB; Claude's own notes share the file). v4.9: when the block is over budget it loses one line at a time — Recent decisions, Topics down to 10, Handoff down to 20, Secrets, Open questions down to 3, then Topics, Handoff, Open questions to 0; Rules and Using memory are never cut.
_notes.gaps: v4.9 gap ledger in MEMORY.md: memfile_lines = open questions (docs/questions.md) listed under `## Open questions` — ask items first (at least 2 when any exist), then research, oldest first, then `+N more`; the newest curator worklog adds a status line above them.
_notes.recall_cards: v4.9 recall.card_enabled / recall.card_max_chars: when a prompt NAMES a topic that has a card (a hyphenated or nested slug or its phrase, an alias of 4+ chars, a single-word slug of 5+ chars that is no stopword), the card is injected before the recalled entries, once per session per topic; its body is capped at min(card_max_chars, on_prompt_max_chars - 600) and the entries use what is left. Prompts of 8-39 bytes reach Python only when they match the machine-local name list .curator/cards-terms-<ws>.
_notes.capture: v4.9 pipeline hygiene. A prompt that STARTS with a bot/pipeline marker — `STAGE=<NAME>` then a newline/./( —, a first line `### TASK|DAILY … ###`, the session summarizer's `Below is a conversation log from a Claude Code coding session` — is a machine record ("starts" = after leading whitespace and one leading `<pasted_content id="xxxx">` opener, the wrapper Claude Code records around a bracketed (tmux) paste): never counted as a turn, captured, recalled, dumped at PreCompact or nagged about SYNC-CONFLICT.md. pipeline_prefixes: extra literal prefixes (each 1-200 chars, at most 20 used, plain startswith on that same start — never a regex). To switch every gowth-mem hook off for a process tree (a bot's tmux / `claude -p` stages) export GOWTH_MEM_OFF=1 instead.
_notes.curator: v4.9 daily curator (_curate.py, agents/curator.md, /mem-ops curate). enabled: once a day, on an otherwise quiet Stop of a real turn (never in a `claude -p`/SDK session), the main session is told to launch ONE background gowth-mem:curator subagent that consolidates the day's session logs and vault changes into reviewed entries, corrections, topic cards, open questions and a worklog (docs/worklog/). hour: earliest local hour it may fire; min_new_turns: unprocessed (non-pipeline) session-log turns needed (with capture off: real turns counted per workspace); first_window_days: the window of the first run; stale_days: handoff live items older than this are listed; max_cards / max_research / max_research_tries: per-run limits (a question tried max_research_tries times is escalated to an ask); retry_minutes: a claimed run without a worklog may be retried once after this; hold_days: a session log with unprocessed turns is kept this long past journal.raw_ttl_days; max_prep_chars: digest budget (8000-200000); model: the subagent's model; hosts: when non-empty, only these hosts curate (else one host per workspace, failover after 2 days). Two claimed days without a worklog pause it until /mem-ops curate now succeeds.
